verdict.rationale:
Airwallex Billing includes a documented Subscription Management product supporting multi-item plans and a broader billing suite (subscriptions, invoicing, checkout), showing recurring billing plan capability exists. However, the evidence never mentions trial periods, plan upgrades/downgrades, or proration logic explicitly.
missing for 10: trial period support, upgrade/downgrade handling, proration calculations, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these subscription lifecycle features.
